forecasts.question: Will Iran resume negotiations with the US before EOD 2026-06-16?

VP Vance confirmed June 15. The June 14 digital signing satisfies the criterion of a publicly confirmed held session between named US and Iranian principals via mediation, or official Iranian statement rescinds the June 1 suspension. p=0.85 reflects high but not absolute certainty due to ambiguity over whether the digital signing constitutes a 'held negotiating session' vs. the June 17 formal signing.
